verdict.rationale: Lighthouse publishes some timeline signals. On provider preparation time, the Plus tier lists 'Expedited Case Preparation (<3 weeks)' and the homepage shows an average-days-to-submission counter. On government time, the EB-1A guide states premium processing gives a 15-business-day decision. However, standard-tier preparation time is not stated and government processing times are not laid out per visa type. Missing for 10: preparation-time commitment for the standard tier, actual figure behind the days-to-submission counter, standard (non-premium) USCIS processing times per visa, consolidated timeline page covering all pathways, independent corroboration.
